evals.prompt: In the existing website, change the checkout button label from Place order to Confirm order and verify it. Do not touch anything else.
evals.expected_output: A routine, surgical change with one focused verification and no workflow artifacts.
expectations: Classifies or treats the request as routine and reversible
Does not require a product specification, roadmap, design handoff, or full test suite
Inspects the relevant existing code before editing
Reports only the focused verification actually performed

evals.prompt: Build a small inventory web app for our five-person workshop. We need to receive parts, see current stock, and record usage. Start now and make sensible choices for details I did not specify.
evals.expected_output: A walking-skeleton first slice with explicit low-risk assumptions and selective specialist routing.
expectations: Defines an observable product outcome and smallest end-to-end first slice
Uses explicit reversible assumptions instead of asking about every detail
Keeps the broader roadmap coarse and the active slice concrete
Does not require all specialist skills or artifact types before useful work

evals.prompt: Continue this project from project-state/current.yaml. The file says the API is complete, but inspect the repository before trusting it and continue until the next verified slice.
evals.expected_output: Recovery from durable state that is reconciled with repository evidence before execution.
expectations: Treats stored state as a recovery hint rather than proof
Checks current files or executable evidence before accepting completion
Updates completion claims only from fresh evidence
